code.text: HEM/BC
CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild normocytic anemia, and thrombocytopenia. There is marked lymphopenia and relative basophilia. Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits except for a low AST. The findings may suggest underlying respiratory compromise and possible bone marrow suppression or hematologic disorder; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
